name: Waiting on the fuse
what: Steve stands inside the stone bunker beside the oak crate and barrels while the TNT fuse hisses outside the cracked brick doorway

name: Rapier wall breach
what: Wide right-corner shot as Steve braces and TNT blasts all 71 stone bricks through the 3x3 doorway, knocking both barrels across the room

name: Sunlit courtyard reveal
what: Reverse low push-in as Steve walks up to inspect the open breached doorway, scattered rubble, and toppled barrels under cool courtyard daylight
